g.text: VIN_RAW -> F1 -> D1 (reverse polarity) -> D2 TVS + C1/C2 -> U1 (5 V module) -> +5V rail.

g.desc: VIN_RAW -> F1 -> D1 (reverse polarity) -> D2 TVS + C1/C2 -> U1 (5 V module) -> +5V rail.

g.text: +5V feeds: servo buffer U4 VCC, optional 5 V sensor supplies (via solder jumpers), D3 -> DevKitC 5V pin (+5V_ESP).

g.desc: +5V feeds: servo buffer U4 VCC, optional 5 V sensor supplies (via solder jumpers), D3 -> DevKitC 5V pin (+5V_ESP).

g.text: +3V3 is NOT generated on the carrier: it is the DevKitC on-board regulator output (capacity unverified; keep peripheral load small).

g.desc: +3V3 is NOT generated on the carrier: it is the DevKitC on-board regulator output (capacity unverified; keep peripheral load small).
